Lǜ Sēnlín Frame™ Towers

Our equipment is built around stackable “frames” — compact, modular units: 1000mm × 500mm × 500mm (L × W × H), that form vertical towers. Frames are lightweight, made from self-healing nanomaterials for durability, and feature plug-and-play slots for growing modules (eg hydroponic pods, aquaponic tanks).

Key Features:

  • Scalable Stacking: - magnetic auto-locking connectors for easy vertical assembly; add or remove frames without tools.
  • Integrated Utilities: - magnetic Water/Power/Data Bus, One snap-in backbone distributes water + 48V DC + high-speed data through every level. Zero cable clutter; add or remove Frames without rewiring.
  • Hydra-Rail™ Fluid Manifold: - micro-drip, fog, or flood modes selectable per Frame; self-sealing/healing NanoHealShield™ couplers prevent spills. Change crops or switch to aquaponics on the fly.
  • PureLight™: - transmits 90% of light of glass whilst providing superior insulation (U-value 0.01–0.02W/(m²·K)). It is lightweight, durable, maximizes photosynthesis by maintaining stable temperatures for year-round crop growth.
  • PrecisionHeat™: - Graphene Heat-Film, printed onto root chamber walls for ±0.3°C control.
  • NanoSunBeam™: Organic-phosphor LEDs auto-tune PAR, far-red & UV-A. Better flavour, longer shelf life, lower kWh.
  • HarvestSage™: - on-board crop neural AI handling seeding, climate, light, filtering, watering, pest control, and harvesting cues. Connects to the Lǜ Sēnlín Cloud. Works off-line in case your Wi-Fi drops.
  • SlideLock™ Shelves: - swap growing modules in < 10s. True plug-and-play.

3 tower configurations to match your space and yield needs—start small and scale up!

  • 1-Frame Tower: - great for beginners or testing. Perfect entry-level for 1-2 produce types (e.g., herbs or microgreens); yields ~2-5kg/year. Height 500mm.
  • 2-Frame Tower: - supports hybrid setups (e.g., veggies + small fish); yields ~5-10kg/year. Height 1000mm.
  • 4-Frame Tower: - maximum yield in minimal space. Enables full ecosystems (e.g., aquaponics with mushrooms, snails, and greens); yields ~10-20kg/year.
